description: Start several computers on one network, each a normal session (every session tool works on the ids returned) with its own full world. Give each world a different computerId, a position and modem peripherals. Modems follow the real rules: 64 blocks low down, rising to 384 at the top of the world; ender modems reach everything; wired modems link through network, or through block plus the cables of `wired`. rednet from the unmodified ROM works over them. The computer gets a copy of the workspace (without .git, node_modules, .runtime and what .gitignore ignores); for a big workspace give world.deploy to copy only some folders.

blocksHigh.description: Monitor height in blocks (1 block = 5 chars at scale 1).

blocksWide.description: Monitor width in blocks (1 block = 7 chars at scale 1).

name.description: Name for this computer; default its id.

world.description: This computer's world, as craftos_run's `world`; its deploy lists the workspace folders this computer gets (each computer can have its own).

worldFile.description: A saved world: a name in the worlds folder (e.g. "advanced-peripherals-demo") or a workspace path to a .json file (e.g. "door.world.json"). Fields in `world` override it.

timeScale.description: Virtual clock speed. 10 makes sleep(), os.clock() and os.epoch() run 10x faster than real time, so slow scripts finish quickly. timeoutMs stays in real time.

cables.description: Cable and full modem blocks; blocks that touch join.

id.description: Modems with this `network` join. Default none.

peripherals.description: Peripherals every computer on the network reaches.

name: craftos_network_create
